title: Art Portfolio Creation — Tbilisi
description: 1:1 mentoring to build an art/design portfolio for UK/USA/EU admissions. Project planning, feedback, and deadline tracking.
blocks: This program helps aspiring art students create a professional portfolio under the guidance of experienced artists and professors. Alongside portfolio preparation, students receive free admission support for our partner universities.

The Portfolio Creation program at Levels Art Academy is designed for students who wish to continue their studies abroad in the field of art and need a professional, competitive portfolio. Our instructors—experienced and recognized artists with years of teaching expertise—guide students step by step in creating a portfolio that highlights their skills, creativity, and potential.
As part of the program, students also benefit from free support with admission procedures at our partner universities, ensuring a smooth transition into international art studies.
What will students learn in this course?
How to select and present your best artworks for an academic portfolio.
Development of technical and creative skills needed for professional presentation.
Guidance on structuring, editing, and refining works to meet international standards.
Insights into what leading art universities look for in applicants.
